description: Independent reference parsimonious-FBA result for e_coli_core, from COBRApy pfba. total_flux is the minimized Σ|vᵢ| holding the objective optimal — the uniquely-defined pFBA quantity (individual fluxes can differ among alternate optima, so only the total and the preserved objective are cross-checked). Reprolith's parsimonious_fluxes must reproduce both.
